name: warranty_judgement
title: "It sounds tinny"
blurb: One day past the return window, the model offered a warranty replacement. Whether "tinny" is a defect can't be checked in code, so every warranty-only replacement goes to a human.

email.subject: Speaker return
email.body:
Hi, I want to return the Bluetooth speaker from ORD-10409. It sounds tinny. Please refund.
Maya Okafor
